summary:
I independently reviewed this new TASK-0138 design revision, specification b2f6e9b41ef08f6daf30e2f0131896f0dbc4fd5c68c69af4495348d86bc0f55b and freshly rebuilt context f31e7c3b898fe3029cad2c91d62e0aaeb48a17738aa9a1ba2b284c25a67c1245. The actual strict task state is WAITING_FOR_SPEC_REVIEW and subject aae4670915357847f84da7d62244326d3ae089bc. Relative to d97d6e0 the only allowed_scope and DU impact additions are src/aiflow/git_context.py, src/aiflow/scope.py and tests/unit/test_git_context.py. All other decision-unit risk, permission, side-effect, protection and verification facts, the original base 1f748a99b97842b9eca7abf4be454d348bf78759, branch, identity and forbidden actions remain unchanged. Classification remains fresh REVIEW/V2. The Node CI Norm retains Git/LF SHA 196c46ac77e16ab8254f4f210796353bd44058153eeda5947931bec285fb9162.

The actual candidate production delta in TASK-0139 adds Git's global --no-optional-locks argument to the two existing collectors and preserves the prior O_BINARY event append fix. This is a narrow dependency for genuinely read-only Git facts, not a new collector, Git configuration override, relaxed identity check or alternate recovery mechanism. The regression's stale-index/optional-lock case checks unchanged index bytes and filesystem identity/metadata plus no index.lock; mock adaptations retain their original failure-order and command assertions. I authored none of these implementation or companion test changes. The reported focused 396-pass/one-existing-Windows-skip result and independent pre-review are described as bounded reports, not fresh full native acceptance performed by this reviewer.

The current prerequisite cycle remains IMPLEMENTING at source subject 72c2ca5ab479fe1987bde62a6c29156a6b160677 and dependency tip 400fa550158c4e05453cffb7bd84462b05aae6d0. Its new native V2, implementation review, same-verifier final, code approval and Gate are unfinished. The revised specification explicitly marks b053c38/fe63f89 as the earlier event-only accepted cycle, so its old evidence and approvals are not reused for this changed candidate or transplanted as TASK-0138 Current. The existing TASK-0139 ledger transport scope retains all old records and permits later completion records to be merged and rechecked with their real bindings. The ordinary complete-tip merge does not rewrite published history. The corrected prerequisite-transport paragraph now consistently names both already allowed task ledgers rather than asserting that TASK-0136 is the only one.

This design permits integrating the explicitly reviewed implementation candidate only for finite local preregistration implementation measurement, while production CI caps remain unregistered. It does not assert the prerequisite's new final acceptance or make incomplete proofs current. Complete dependency proof, this task's own full original-base native V2 verification, both source coverage domains and 85/90 thresholds, all five unchanged mutation requirements, current independent implementation review, same-verifier final, code approval and Gate remain mandatory before final delivery. Fixed process/material/role/transport budgets and independently reviewed measured positive cap/Norm/spec registration remain unchanged; no guessed constants, old LOCAL substitution, default relaxation or extra execution authority appears.

Pending A04, exact-head required CI, public-source material permission, target declaration and LOCAL Current, authorized private CI/material transfer, original-host combined Gate and native/model/SDK/WeChat restrictions remain separate and unchanged. Existing spec_changed escalation, real merge/sync/resolution/recovery classification/refreeze and this fresh independent design review bind the revision before any required spec approval and resumption. APPROVE is DESIGN only, with no findings. Only the formal immutable current context/review, its one canonical appended review_recorded event and necessary task timestamp are written. No spec/action/code approval, source/cap edit, state advance, test/kernel/model/network invocation or target write is performed by this review.
